Scenario: User signs up with a valid email and password
Expected Result: Account is created; verification email sent
Inline error requires a stronger password before submission

Scenario: User resets password via email link
Steps: 1. Request password reset 2. Open emailed link 3. Set new password
Expected Result: User can log in with the new password immediately after

Scenario: Admin user can access the admin settings page
Steps: 1. Log in as admin 2. Navigate to Settings
Expected Result: Admin settings page loads with full controls visible

Scenario: Standard user cannot access admin-only pages
Steps: 1. Log in as member 2. Try to open /admin URL directly
Expected Result: User is redirected or shown a 403/forbidden message

Scenario: Dashboard widgets load with correct account data
Expected Result: Widgets show accurate, up-to-date figures for the logged-in account

Scenario: Dashboard handles a brand-new account with zero data
Steps: 1. Log in as new user 2. Open dashboard
Expected Result: Empty-state messaging is shown instead of broken charts or errors

Scenario: User updates their profile name and it reflects app-wide
Steps: 1. Go to Settings 2. Change display name 3. Save
Expected Result: Updated name appears in header, comments, and account menu

Scenario: User changes email and must reverify
Expected Result: Account is flagged unverified until the new email is confirmed

Scenario: User receives an in-app notification for a relevant event
Steps: 1. Trigger the event (e.g. teammate comment) 2. Check notification bell
Expected Result: Notification appears with correct content and links to the right place

Scenario: User can turn off email notifications for a category
Steps: 1. Go to Notification Settings 2. Disable a category 3. Trigger that event
Expected Result: No email is sent for that category after it's disabled

Scenario: Admin invites a new team member by email
Steps: 1. Go to Team page 2. Enter email 3. Send invite
Expected Result: Invitee receives an invite email; pending status shown in team list

Scenario: Inviting an already-registered team member is handled cleanly
Steps: 1. Try to invite an existing member's email
Expected Result: Clear message that the user is already on the team; no duplicate invite

Scenario: Billing page displays the current plan correctly
Expected Result: Current plan name and renewal date are displayed accurately

Scenario: User is logged out on all devices after a password change
Steps: 1. Change password on device A 2. Check session on device B
Expected Result: Device B's session is invalidated and requires re-login
